 Dengue death toll reaches 502 as 3 more die
 The Report Desk 
 Published: November 16, 2026, 06:43 PM 
 -->
 -->
 Photo: Collected
 Three more people have died from dengue in Bangladesh, while 1,598 were admitted to hospitals across the country in the 24 hours till 8:00 am today, according to the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS).
 With the latest deaths, the country‍‍`s dengue death toll has reached 502 this year.
 Dhaka Division recorded the highest number of new hospitalisations, with 673 patients. Chattogram reported 251 cases, followed by Khulna with 201, Barishal with 185, Rajshahi with 145, Rangpur with 71, Mymensingh with 61 and Sylhet with 11.
 The DGHS report said a total of 164,107 people have been hospitalised with dengue across the country so far this year.
 Of them, 157,988 have recovered and returned home after receiving treatment.
 Last year, 102,861 people were infected with dengue and 413 died from the mosquito-borne disease.
